title: Discussion forms and code of conduct
summary: GitHub Discussions now has forms for each category, and the project has a code of conduct.
changes: Add discussion forms for the Help, Ideas and Releases and deploys categories; Help and Ideas forms ask people to confirm they have removed personal data and that the post is not a security problem.
Fix the security advisory link in the issue chooser and add links to the Help and Ideas discussions.
Add CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md covering standards, privacy, security reporting and enforcement.
version_rationale: Patch: repository community files only. Application code, routes, permissions and stored data are unchanged.
validation: All forms parse and pass yamllint.
Release history validation and the full PHPUnit suite in CI.
known_limitations: Polls cannot be limited to maintainers in GitHub, so polls from others are closed by hand.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
